title: Text completions report user tier
summary:
A small text API update makes user tier visible in completions and easier to track.

Text completions gained a `user_tier` field showing the authenticated tier or `anonymous`. Event tracking now records tier as well, and the model-name discovery script displays it alongside results.

daily.title: Tier in text completions
daily.text: Text completion responses now include `user_tier`, showing the authenticated tier or `anonymous`. [Explore the API docs](https://gen.pollinations.ai/docs).
